_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY - copy this to config/everythingrgbprofiles/layouts/ and edit.
Files in that folder describe a board this mod has no geometry for.
match  : glob against the device name your backend reported.
keys   : the backend's own LED names -> [x, y].
Units are arbitrary; only proportions matter, because each device is
normalised to 0..1 on load. Two rules that DO matter:
y increases DOWNWARD  (get this backwards and rain falls upward)
To find the LED names: set debug.enabled = true in the mod config and
look in latest.log at startup. Every LED is listed with its exact name.
A partial layout is fine. Keys you leave out keep whatever position the
backend guessed, so you can describe the main block and ignore the rest.
